svg.title: Google Shopping Feed Ownership Map
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-shopping-feed-ownership; chapter number: 11; chart type: org_architecture; title: Google Shopping Feed Ownership Map; subtitle: In Shopping and Performance Max the feed is the targeting; caption: Operators front-load titles with the converting search term, keep price and availability identical to the site, never change product IDs, and segment with custom labels by margin, price bucket and season.; assumptions note: Practitioners did not specify team size; roles describe the feed responsibilities they name, which one operator may hold together.; note: Sources: Grow My Ads [hY8ZBC3A4uQ @ 00:10:45; 00:13:00], Ecom Chris [d9kULGtUBD4 @ 00:12:01; XQTEnn-3t0E @ 00:23:16], Max Crakanthorp [H4yH9xs030Q @ 00:13:46], KeyCommerce [S1NhYxaPnic @ 00:06:21], Tim Sutton [APb0cOGKROE @ 00:05:06].; center: role: Feed owner; headcount: Not specified by practitioners; focus: Locks product IDs and edits inside the feed app; poorly optimized feeds pay 2-3x the CPC (Ecom Chris).; spokes: role: Title and category editor; type: Feed content; kpi: 10x clicks and impressions on the Home Reserve sofa retitle; 20-30% more sales on a jacket retitle; role: Image curator; type: Creative assets; kpi: 2-3x CTR lift from lifestyle images added behind the white-background main; role: Price and promotion auditor; type: Compliance; kpi: Sale price identical to the live site; promotion end time set to 11:59 p.m.; role: Custom label segmenter; type: Bidding structure; kpi: Price buckets from 100 to 10,000 with a 2,000+ label on its own tROAS
